title: ON THE WINGS OF A SNOW - WHITE DOVE

lines.text: On the wings of a dove.
On the wings of a snow-white dove,
God sends down His pure, sweet love,
On the wings of a dove.
He was born in a stable,
On the wings of a dove.
On the wings of a dove.

chords:
[Verse 1]
[E]Noah had drifted
On the [A]floods many [E]days,
He [E]searched for land
In va[B]rious ways;
[E]Troubles he had some,
But not from a[A]bove,
God [E]gave him His sign
On the [B]wings of a [E]dove.

[Chorus]
On the [E]wings of a snow-white [A]dove,
God sends down His [E]pure, sweet love,
A [E]sign from above,
On the wings of a dove.

[Verse 2]
[E]Jesus, our Saviour
Came to [A]earth one [E]day;
He was [E]born in a stable,
In a [B]manger of hay;

[Verse 3]
Though [E]here rejected,
But not from above,
God [E]gave us His sign
On the wings of a dove.

[Verse 4]
Though [E]I have suffered
In [A]many a [E]way,
I [E]cried for healing
Both [B]night and day,

[Verse 5]
Faith [E]wasn't forgotten
By the [A]Father above,
He [E]gave me His sign,
On the wings of a dove.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Noah had drifted
On the floods many days,
He searched for land
In various ways;
Troubles he had some,
But not from above,
God gave him His sign
On the wings of a dove.

[Chorus]
On the wings of a snow-white dove,
God sends down His pure, sweet love,
A sign from above,
On the wings of a dove.

[Verse 2]
Jesus, our Saviour
Came to earth one day;
He was born in a stable,
In a manger of hay;

[Verse 3]
Though here rejected,
But not from above,
God gave us His sign
On the wings of a dove.

[Verse 4]
Though I have suffered
In many a way,
I cried for healing
Both night and day,

[Verse 5]
Faith wasn't forgotten
By the Father above,
He gave me His sign,
On the wings of a dove.
